senses.gloss: गह् (cf. गभ॑ and √ गाह्) cl. 10. P. गहयति, to enter deeply into (acc.), Dhātup. xxxv, 84 (cf. √ जंह्.)
गह ? See दुर्-ग्˚.
गाह mfn. (g. पचादि) ifc. ‘diving into’, see उद-, उदक-
गाह m. depth, interior, innermost recess, RV. ix, 110, 8
गहादि a Gaṇa of Pāṇ. (iv, 2, 138; Gaṇar. 317-321.)
ग॑हन mf(आ)n. (g. क्षुभ्नादि) deep, dense, thick, impervious, impenetrable, inexplicable, hard to be understood, MBh.; R. &c.
ग॑हन n. an abyss, depth (‘water’, Naigh.; Nir.), RV. x, 129, 1
an inaccessible place, hiding-place, thicket, cave, wood, impenetrable darkness, i, 132, 6; ŚBr. xiv, 7, 2, 17; MBh. &c.
pain, distress, L.
a metre consisting of thirty-two syllables.
ग॑हना f. ornament, DevīP.
गाहन n. diving into, bathing, Daś. xii, 111.
गहन—त्व n. density, Sāh. ii, 6/7 (अति-)
impenetrability, MBh. ii, 2355.
गहन—वत् mfn. having hiding-places or thickets, W.
गहनी-कृत mfn. made inaccessible, Kād. v, 1018.
गहनाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, ‘to lie in wait for any one in a secret place’, to have treacherous intentions towards another, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 14, Vārtt.
गहि m. pl. N. of a family, Pravar. ii, 4, 1.
गाही f. g. गौरादि (Gaṇar.)
गहीय mfn. fr. ˚ह, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 138.
गह्म॑न् m. (= ग॑म्भन्) depth, TBr. ii, 7, 7, 6 (v.l. गंह्˚).
ग॑ह्य m. N. of an Agni, TS.
गाह्य mfn. See दुर्-ग्˚.
ग॑ह्वर mf(आ, ई)n. (g. अश्मादि) deep, impervious, impenetrable, TS. v; Hariv.; BhP.
confused (in mind), Kathās. lxi, 39 and 41
ग॑ह्वर m. an arbour, bower, L.
a cave, cavern, L.
ग॑ह्वर n. ‘an abyss, depth’ (‘water’, Naigh.; Nir.) See ˚रे-ष्ठ॑
a hiding-place, thicket, wood, AV. xii, 2, 53; MBh.; R. &c.
an impenetrable secret, riddle, MBh. xiii, 1388
a deep sigh, L.
hypocrisy, L.
Abrus precatorius (?), L.
ग॑ह्वरा f. the plant Embelia Ribes, L.
ग॑ह्वरी f. a cave, cavern, L.
the earth, Gal.
गह्वरी-भूत mfn. having become a desert or vacuity, Hariv. 11285.
गह्वरे-ष्ठ॑ mfn. being at the bottom or lowest depths, VS. v, 8; xvi, 44; KaṭhUp. ii.
गह्वरित mfn. absorbed (in one's thoughts), MBh. ii, 2294.
गहने-ष्ठ॑ mf(आ)n. being in the depth, MaitrS.
गाहनीय mfn. to be dived into, 98 and 111.
गाहित mfn. plunged into, bathed in W.
shaken, agitated, W.
destroyed, W.
गाहित n. depth, interior, MBh. iii, 8772.
गाहितृ mfn. (cf. Pāṇ. vii, 2, 44, Kāś.) one who plunges into or bathes, W.
one who penetrates, W.
shaking, agitating, W.
destroying, W.
